items.title: David Friesen interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 24, 2024
items.q: “Our Man in Jazz” Henry Grimes, with Billy Higgins, Don Cherry and Sonny of course.

ctx.x: Okay. At what point do titles come to you and attach themselves to songs?

Yeah you know I have a sheet — a sheet on my iPhone under notes and it’s funny, the relationship there, a funny pun notes, it is notes, of different titles that come to me and I write them down. And then I’ll have a tune and it will fit this title. Sometimes the title and the music comes together at the same time, something I haven’t written down. So there’s — it’s different all the time. It’s different. Now “This Light Has No Darkness” this is the new album with the 33-piece chamber orchestra program. This is…
